'''Neural jacks''' were components of [[Cybernetics/Legends|cybernetic]] interface bands such as the [[221 cyber-interface]]. Neural jacks connected the interface directly to the [[Cyborg/Legends|cyborg's]] cerebellum.<ref name="J15">{{JournalCite|15|The Great Herdship Heist}}</ref>
